world.title: What happens when AI becomes the first confidant in a mental health crisis?
world.summary: AI chatbots are increasingly becoming the first point of contact for individuals, especially youth, during mental health crises. They offer 24/7 availability, non-judgmental responses, and instant interaction. However, experts caution that these tools cannot fully replace human support and intervention, highlighting the importance of professional help in addressing complex emotional issues and ensuring effective mental health care.

world.title: US lawmakers seek blacklist of three Indian IT firms over hacking allegations
world.summary: US lawmakers are pressing the Trump administration to blacklist three Indian IT firms linked to allegations of hack-for-hire operations and ongoing espionage against American individuals. The request highlights concerns over cybersecurity and foreign interference, as the firms are accused of facilitating unauthorized access to sensitive information. The situation underscores the growing scrutiny of foreign tech companies operating in the U.S.

world.title: Algeria cuts diplomatic ties with UAE
world.summary: Algeria has severed diplomatic ties with the United Arab Emirates, citing "provocative and hostile acts." The Algerian government accused the UAE of destabilizing nations including Libya, Sudan, and Mali. As part of this decision, Algeria will close its airspace to UAE flights starting Friday. This move marks a significant escalation in tensions between the two countries.

business.title: KPMG audit revealed OP Bhatt suppressed key information as Coforge board chair
business.summary: OP Bhatt resigned as Coforge chairman following a KPMG audit that revealed he suppressed critical board evaluation findings. The audit identified inconsistencies in reports and noted that Bhatt's low scores were not disclosed to all directors. Investors raised concerns after KPMG pointed out these discrepancies and potential legal violations. Vivek Sharma has been appointed as interim chairperson.

business.title: Fed, eyeing inflation data, may lean toward a hike, traders bet
business.summary: Traders anticipate a higher likelihood of the Federal Reserve raising short-term borrowing costs at its upcoming meeting, following the release of key inflation data. Reports indicate that U.S. producer prices increased by 5.4% in August, contributing to expectations of a potential rate hike. The Fed's decision will be closely monitored as it assesses inflation trends.

business.title: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigns, warns AI could ‘kill us all by the end of the decade’: ‘They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence’
business.summary: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon has resigned, expressing concerns about the rapid development of artificial intelligence. He warns that AI labs are "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence," which could lead to catastrophic consequences. Coxon emphasizes the urgency of addressing these risks, suggesting that without proper oversight, AI could pose significant threats to humanity by the end of the decade.

technology.title: Spectroscopic Analysis of Graphene and Carbon Nanotubes
technology.summary: Microspectrophotometry has been developed for non-destructive characterization of graphene and carbon nanotubes (CNTs), which are significant nanomaterials in modern science. Graphene consists of a two-dimensional lattice of sp2-bonded carbon, while CNTs are one-dimensional cylinders formed by rolling a graphene sheet. This technique aids in research, quality control, and process development for these advanced materials.

technology.title: Valheim 1.0 New Weapons and Armors
technology.summary: Valheim 1.0 introduces new weapons and armors in the Deep North biome. Notable among them is the Nord Sword, a one-handed weapon weighing 0.8 with a durability of 400. It offers a slash damage of 170, block armor of 66, and various bonuses for parrying and backstabbing. Players can craft it using specific materials, enhancing gameplay options.

technology.title: GPT Images 2.5 promises edits that leave the rest of your image alone
technology.summary: OpenAI launched GPT Images 2.5, featuring two new models, Flare and Sunburst, designed for image editing. Flare focuses on speed, while Sunburst emphasizes precision, allowing users to modify specific areas of an image without affecting the rest. However, the real-world latency and cost differences between the two models remain unclear, leaving developers to explore their capabilities further.

sports.title: How Aryna Sabalenka’s fiancé Georgios Frangulis built his own empire before becoming her biggest supporter
sports.summary: Georgios Frangulis, Aryna Sabalenka's fiancé, is a Brazilian entrepreneur who built his own business empire before supporting her at Grand Slam events. He left law school to establish an açaí brand and has since expanded his entrepreneurial ventures. Frangulis's journey highlights his dedication to both his professional pursuits and his role as a supportive partner in Sabalenka's tennis career.

sports.title: US Open tennis 2026 women’s semi-finals: Rybakina beats Gauff to set up Sabalenka final - as it happened
sports.summary: Elena Rybakina defeated Coco Gauff in the US Open women's semi-finals, advancing to the final against Aryna Sabalenka. Sabalenka expressed her happiness after a challenging quarter-final match against Linda Noskova. The upcoming final will showcase both players' resilience and skill as they compete for the prestigious title at the 2026 US Open.

sports.title: US Open tennis 2026 women’s semi-finals: Rybakina beats Gauff to set up Sabalenka final - as it happened
sports.summary: Elena Rybakina defeated Coco Gauff in the US Open women's semi-finals, securing her place in the final against Aryna Sabalenka, who won against Jessica Pegula. The matches showcased strong performances, with Sabalenka's dominance noted by Pegula in her post-match comments. The final will feature Rybakina and Sabalenka, highlighting a competitive tournament leading to this anticipated matchup.

health.title: Revolutionary IISc Antivenom Neutralizes Cobra Venom, Saves Mice in Groundbreaking Tests
health.summary: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Science have developed an innovative antivenom using engineered antibody fragments that effectively neutralize cobra venom. Laboratory tests demonstrated its efficacy against venom from various cobra species, including spectacled and monocled cobras, as well as Indian king cobras. This advancement holds promise for addressing the significant issue of snakebites in India.

health.title: SGPGI hosts session on rising premature heart disease
health.summary: SGPGI hosted a session addressing the increasing incidence of premature heart disease in India, emphasizing lifestyle risks, the importance of early screening, and prevention strategies. The event featured discussions by cardiologists and physician-filmmakers, inspired by the documentary “The Brown Heart.” The session aimed to raise awareness about the factors contributing to this health issue among the Indian population.

health.title: Aizawl, Sep 10 (UNI) Mizoram has the highest H…
health.summary: Mizoram has the highest HIV/AIDS prevalence rate in India at 2.85%, according to the Mizoram State AIDS Control Society. A total of 34,745 HIV-positive cases have been detected in the state from October 1990 to June 2026. The data highlights the ongoing public health challenge posed by HIV/AIDS in the region, necessitating continued awareness and intervention efforts.

science.title: Cleveland Research Team Identifies Biological Mechanism That May Explain Obesity Relapse
science.summary: A Cleveland research team identified a biological mechanism explaining obesity relapse after dieting or discontinuing GLP-1 medications. They found that obesity creates a lasting "memory" in fat cells, maintaining elevated hunger signals post-weight loss. This "memory" can be transmitted from mother to child before birth. Blocking the asprosin pathway showed potential in preventing weight regain and inherited obesity risk.

science.title: The Sun's most detailed images yet reveal whirlpools never spotted before
science.summary: Scientists have captured the Sun's most detailed images to date, revealing previously unseen whirlpools on its surface. This enhanced view is crucial for understanding the Sun's dynamics, which play a vital role in maintaining the solar system's structure. The Sun influences everything from planetary orbits to seasonal changes and climate patterns, highlighting its importance in the solar system.

science.title: IBM, Nasa launch AI model to help map ice, craters on Moon
science.summary: IBM and NASA have launched an open-source AI model aimed at enhancing the analysis of lunar observation data. In benchmark tests, the model demonstrated up to 23 percent greater accuracy in identifying key features on the Moon's surface compared to traditional methods. This initiative supports ongoing efforts for sustained lunar exploration and research.
